story: At 6:17 on a sunny Tuesday evening in Sumter Oaks, Donna and Rosa sit together at Rosa's dining table, sketching removable Halloween decorations for the parade cart with an eye toward keeping everything tidy and approved. Gary is making his way down Magnolia Loop, while Hal, resolute as ever, heads for the Town Square. The October warmth still hangs over the community at 81 degrees, and the golf carts are quietly parked along the curbs.
events: Gary headed to Magnolia Loop (the street).

gary.thought_process: I've filed the application, left the sketches and clamp list in the drop box, and signed the cart up for Saturday's parade with a note that the lights and sound are pending review. There's nobody around in the square and nothing more I can do on the paperwork until the committee answers. I could grab an ice cream, but it's better to use the evening on the cart itself. I can dry-fit the wiring and mounting at home so everything's ready the minute approval comes through, without anything visible from the street. Home is down Magnolia Loop, so I'll head that way.

parameters.content: Heading home to dry-fit the wiring and mounts in the garage so the cart is ready the minute Review signs off.

donna.thought_process: Rosa has the table cleared and paper and pencils laid out, and Hal hasn't arrived yet. The Review notice isn't filed, so the sketches are the next step toward the parade cart. Time to dive in rather than chat more. I'll use the dining table and draw removable decorations that stay Review-friendly under L-01. Gary's pickleball practice can wait until after.

parameters.content: Sit down with Rosa and start sketching the removable Halloween parade cart decorations, keeping everything Review-friendly

hal.thought_process: I've read the bulletin board and counted flamingos several times already. No one's around, and notebook logging is getting repetitive. My real goal is filing the complaints on Gary's cart and Donna's flamingos with the architectural review committee, and L-02 caps visible ornaments at three. A full count from the street is the last bit of evidence I need, but I've logged it plenty. Time to stop dawdling and go to Town Square to see about filing, or at least check committee meeting info. I'll head there.

parameters.content: Heading to Town Square to file my report on the cart modifications and the flamingo count with the committee.

rosa.thought_process: Donna is already sketching at the dining table, so the best thing I can do is sit down and draw alongside her instead of talking more. Hal isn't here yet and Gary's apparently handling drinks, but my goal is to get them all at one table to finish the cart design, and the sketches are step one before filing with Architectural Review. I'll draw the removable decorations so nothing is permanent and nothing trips L-01.

parameters.content: Sit down beside Donna and sketch removable Halloween decorations for the parade cart

laws.title: Cart Modifications
laws.text: Exterior golf cart modifications visible from the street require Architectural Review approval.

laws.title: Lawn Ornaments
laws.text: No more than 3 decorative ornaments may be visible from the street.

laws.title: Quiet Hours
laws.text: No amplified sound from 10 PM to 7 AM.

laws.title: Holiday Decor
laws.text: Holiday lighting is permitted from Thanksgiving through January 15.

laws.title: Court Reservations
laws.text: Pickleball courts may be reserved for a maximum of 2 hours per party.

laws.title: Parking
laws.text: No parking on the grass. Carts and cars stay on driveways or the street.
